observations: Adding another directory under an existing marketplace name requires removing the old registration first.
Marketplace remove followed by add preserves the plugin enabled config and exact existing cache including an untracked sentinel.
Plugin discovery is temporarily empty between remove and add; after add identity/version/enabled remain unchanged.
Negative control: plugin add for the same version replaces the cache and removes the sentinel. Migration never calls plugin add or remove.

regressions: Authored version changes and incomplete, corrupt or rejected copies remain invisible behind the prior complete catalog pointer.
Same-version changed payload and downgrade refuse; identical bytes permit retry.
Pair owner prunes older published packages only after complete device and cache readback.
Migration preserves exact identity, enabled=false and full cache inventory using official marketplace commands.
A remove operation that succeeds before reporting failure is recovered by observed registry state.
Failed rollback retains a pinned durable intent; another invocation resumes without reinstalling or rewriting cache.
One OS flock is inherited by Node and the Codex CLI child; closing Python and killing its isolated Node adapter keeps exclusivity until the CLI completes.
The next leased attempt discards orphan unpublished copy stages without changing the current package.
